privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.body:
PacerGo helps you find workout partners and trainers and plan your training. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, who handles it, and the choices you have. By creating an account you agree to it.

## Who we are

PacerGo ("we", "us") runs the PacerGo web app and website. For any question or request about your data, contact us at **pacergov1@gmail.com** or through the Support page in the app.

## What we collect

- **Account and profile:** your email address, password (stored in hashed form by our authentication provider), display name, photo, banner, bio and the city or area you enter.
- **Profile Setup (optional):** your main activity (gym, running, hiking or other), your current level, and your city.
- **Fitness profile (optional, used by AI Training and AI Nutrition):** gender (male or female), age, height, weight, fitness goal, daily activity level, training experience, training days, session length, available equipment, and the training plans, nutrition estimates and workout records (weights, reps and effort feedback) that are created from or entered alongside them. Body measurements are personal data that you choose to give us.
- **Bookings, messages and reviews:** bookings you make or receive, chat messages with other users, ratings you give, and reports or blocks you submit.
- **Payments:** payments are processed by NewebPay. We receive the order, amount and payment status. We do not store your card number.
- **If you apply as a trainer:** verification documents you upload (a certification or ID image), and the bank account details you provide so we can pay you out.
- **Location:** if you allow it in your browser, your device's location, used to show partners and trainers near you.
- **Technical data:** cookies that keep you signed in and remember your language, and a record of which versions of our legal documents you accepted and when.

## How we use it

- To run the service: accounts, matching, bookings, chat, payments and payouts.
- To personalise training plans and nutrition estimates for you.
- To keep PacerGo safe: verifying trainers, reviewing reports, preventing abuse, and giving support.
- To understand how PacerGo is used, in aggregate. We may count and share summary statistics, such as the number of registered users and the most common activities, levels and cities. These do not identify you.
- To meet legal obligations.

## Who can see it

- **Other users** see your public profile: name, photo, bio, level, area and ratings. People you book with, or chat with, see the information needed for that booking or conversation.
- **Your fitness profile, nutrition estimates and workout records are private to you.** Authorised PacerGo administrators can access account data only where needed to run the service, give support, review safety reports and verify trainers.
- **Service providers** that process data for us: Supabase (database, sign-in and file storage, hosted in Tokyo, Japan), Vercel (web hosting), NewebPay (payments), and our email delivery provider (verification and password-reset emails). They may only use the data to provide their service to us.
- **Authorities**, when the law requires it.
- We do not sell your personal data.

## How long we keep it

We keep your data while your account is active. You can delete your account in the app (Profile page). Deleting it removes your profile and the data linked to it from our systems. Some records, such as payment and booking records, may be kept where we need them for accounting, dispute handling or legal obligations.

## Your choices and rights

- You can view and edit your profile and Fitness Profile in the app, and skip any optional question.
- You can refuse location access in your browser and still use PacerGo.
- You can delete your account at any time.
- Under Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act you may ask to access, receive a copy of, correct, stop the use of, or delete your personal data. Email **pacergov1@gmail.com** and we will respond within a reasonable time.

## Health and fitness information

Training plans and nutrition figures (calories, protein) are general estimates based on what you tell us. They are not medical advice. Talk to a qualified professional before making big changes to your training or diet, especially if you have a health condition.

## Security

Data is sent over encrypted connections, and the database is set up so each user can read only their own private data. No system is perfectly secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## Children

PacerGo is not intended for children under 13. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

## Changes to this policy

When we change this policy we will update the date shown above, and tell you in the app if the change is significant.

seeker.title: Member booking & safety terms (draft, pending legal review)
seeker.body:
These terms apply to the session you are booking through PacerGo. Please read them before you pay.

### 1. The service and exercise risks
- PacerGo connects members with trainers. The session is provided by the trainer.
- Exercise carries risks, including muscle strains, sprains, falls, dehydration, heat illness and, in rare cases, heart problems. You understand and accept the ordinary risks of exercise.
- You confirm your health allows you to take part, and you will tell the trainer before the session about any illness, past injury, pregnancy, medication or other limits. If you are unsure, ask a doctor first.
- If you feel pain, dizziness, chest tightness, shortness of breath or anything else wrong, stop at once and tell the trainer.

### 2. Respect, personal boundaries and no harassment
- Both sides treat each other with respect. No discrimination, insults, threats, stalking or harassment of any kind.
- Sexual harassment is strictly prohibited. This includes unwelcome sexual remarks or jokes, advances or invitations, pressing for a personal relationship, sending sexual messages or images, and any inappropriate touching.
- Any physical contact the training needs (for example spotting or adjusting your form) must be explained first and needs your consent. You can refuse or take back your consent at any time.
- If you feel uncomfortable or a boundary is crossed, you may end the session at once and report it to PacerGo. PacerGo may suspend or remove the account of anyone who breaks these rules, and may cooperate with the authorities.

### 3. Your safety and conduct
- Meet in a public place or a proper venue you both agreed on, and let a friend or family member know your plans.
- Wear suitable clothes and shoes, and bring water and anything you personally need, such as your own medication.
- Do not take part after drinking alcohol, after taking anything that affects your judgment, or when clearly unwell.
- Follow the venue's rules and the trainer's safety instructions, and keep in touch through PacerGo messages so there is a record.

### 4. Cancellations, refunds and reporting incidents
- To change or cancel after paying, message the trainer; the trainer cancels the booking. When a trainer cancels a paid booking, PacerGo refunds it to the original payment method.
- Refund requests after the session has ended are reviewed by PacerGo support.
- In an emergency, first call 119 (ambulance, fire) or 110 (police).
- Report any injury, accident, harassment or dispute to PacerGo as soon as you can, at pacergov1@gmail.com or through the in-app support page, with the booking details.

companion.title: Trainer responsibilities & safety terms (draft, pending legal review)
companion.body:
These terms apply to the session you are accepting on PacerGo. Please read them before you accept.

### 1. Your responsibilities and safety duties
- Arrive on time at the agreed place. Before starting, check the member's health, past injuries, experience and how they feel that day.
- Match the content and intensity to the member's level and build up gradually. Never push a member beyond what they can safely do.
- Check that the venue, equipment and weather are safe. If in doubt, adjust, postpone or cancel the session.
- Stop the session at once if the member shows warning signs such as pain, dizziness, chest tightness or shortness of breath.

### 2. Respect, personal boundaries and no harassment
- Respect the member's boundaries, privacy and decisions. No discrimination, insults, threats, stalking or harassment of any kind.
- Sexual harassment is strictly prohibited. This includes sexual remarks or jokes, advances or invitations, pressing for a personal relationship, and sending sexual messages or images.
- Do not take photos or video of the member, or use their personal information outside PacerGo, without their consent.

### 3. No inappropriate physical contact or behavior
- Physical contact is limited to what the training needs (for example spotting or adjusting form). Explain the purpose and where you will touch first, and get the member's clear consent. Stop at once if they refuse or take back consent.
- Never touch private areas, and never make contact that is sexual or unrelated to the training.
- Do not coach after drinking alcohol or taking anything that affects your judgment. Do not invite members to a private home or anywhere unrelated to the session.

### 4. Stay within your qualifications and experience
- Offer only the activities and tiers PacerGo has approved for you, and describe your certificates and experience truthfully.
- Do not give medical diagnoses, treatment, rehabilitation or diet prescriptions beyond your qualifications. When needed, suggest the member see a doctor or another professional.

### 5. Emergencies and reporting incidents
- Know where the venue's exits, the nearest AED and the nearest hospital or clinic are.
- In a serious injury or emergency, call 119 at once, give first aid within your training, and stay with the member until help arrives.
- Report any injury, accident, harassment complaint or dispute to PacerGo within 24 hours, at pacergov1@gmail.com or through the in-app support page.

### 6. Breaking these terms
- PacerGo may pause your bookings, suspend or remove your account, and may cooperate with the authorities.

gym.title: Gym training safety
gym.body:
- **Equipment:** check equipment before use. Use collars on barbells, and use safety bars or a spotter for squats and bench presses.
- **Weights:** choose loads you can lift with good form, increase them gradually, and never attempt a weight beyond your ability.
- **Physical contact:** spotting and form adjustments are explained first and need consent.
- **Injury prevention:** warm up before, cool down after, and drink water. Stop at once on sharp pain.
- Follow the gym's rules and opening hours.

walking.title: Walking safety
walking.body:
- **Road safety:** use sidewalks and obey traffic signals. Wear reflective or bright clothing at night or early morning.
- **Weather:** check the forecast before setting out. Avoid the hottest hours, typhoons and heavy rain. Use sun protection and drink water.
- **Physical limits:** keep a pace at which the member can still talk, and adjust distance and slope to their fitness. Rest at once on dizziness, chest tightness or joint pain.
- Wear suitable walking shoes.

running.title: Running safety
running.body:
- **Pace:** agree on pace and distance before starting, and adjust to the member's ability. Beginners run at an easy, conversational pace.
- **Endurance:** do not suddenly add a lot of distance or intensity. Plan enough rest, water and food.
- **Traffic:** prefer parks, riverside paths or tracks. Where there is no sidewalk, run facing oncoming traffic. With headphones, keep the volume low enough to hear your surroundings.
- **Heat:** in summer avoid the midday heat and drink plenty. On signs of heat exhaustion or heatstroke (dizziness, nausea, no longer sweating, confusion), stop at once, move to shade, cool down and call 119.

hiking.title: Hiking safety
hiking.body:
- **Terrain:** pick a route that suits both of you. Check trail conditions and closures before setting out, and watch for falling rocks, slippery ground and steep slopes.
- **Weather:** mountain weather changes fast. Check the forecast and the chance of afternoon thunderstorms, and turn back if the weather turns bad.
- **Navigation:** carry an offline map or GPX track, tell someone your route and expected return time, and stay together the whole way.
- **Equipment:** shoes with good grip, rain gear, warm layers, enough water and food, a headlamp, a first-aid kit and a charged phone. Apply in advance for a mountain permit where the route needs one.
- **Emergencies:** if lost, injured or getting dangerously cold, stay where you are, call 119 or 112 and share your location.

hyrox.title: HYROX safety
hyrox.body:
- **High intensity:** HYROX combines running with functional workout stations and is very demanding on heart, lungs and muscles. Warm up thoroughly.
- **Physical limits:** scale weights, distances and reps to your ability and take rests. Stop at once on chest tightness, dizziness or shortness of breath.
- **Equipment:** learn proper technique for sleds, rowers, ski ergs, kettlebells, sandbags and wall balls before using them, check them first, and keep clear of other people's equipment.
- **Injury prevention:** technique comes before speed. Lower the intensity when tired, stop at once on sharp pain, and drink water.
